about: Regression ladder rung 3 (docs/agents/regression-ladder.md): each core-claim incident and B1.5d case study names the normal-suite test that replays it. tests/incident-replays.test.mjs fails if a named test is renamed, removed, skipped or moved out of tests/*.test.mjs.

replays.what: B1.5d n3-r3 attempt 1: a land --save ran 1555 s and ended LANDING_STALLED; the agent hunted for its landing state
replays.test: B1.5d n3-r3 t23938: stall alarm remains pending; terminal stall has one successful retry

replays.what: B1.5d n3-r3 attempt 1: resolve from the wrong folder sent t19456 help hunting
replays.test: B1.5d n3-r3 t19456: wrong editing root names one exact resolve location without help hunting

replays.what: B1.5d n3-r3 attempt 1: a cell 3x slower than its norm raised no alert
replays.test: incident replay n3-r3 a1: three slow landings in a day alert once on time to main, naming the next step

replays.what: B1.5d t27456 conflict recovery: re-land with markers, resolve from a subdirectory, overtaken during its check
replays.test: B1.5d t27456 ${cell}: rejected re-land, resolve from subdirectory, followed continuation lands

replays.what: Core claim: land --save by Lane id from a foreign folder landed an empty Lane and reported LANDED
replays.test: incident replay: land by Lane id with head == base and unsaved edits is refused, naming count and command

replays.what: Core claim: the dev queue stalled ~30 min after a lost finish wake stranded a passed head
replays.test: incident replay c329d191: a lost finish wake after an order wait never strands a passed head

replays.what: Core claim: every running-check progress event woke the queue (OCC contention behind the stall)
replays.test: incident c329d191: running-check progress writes the queue row at most once a minute

replays.what: Core claim: a check dispatch threw, the run stayed unknown with no executionId and the queue head sat checking for up to 12 h
replays.test: incident a7de3a93 replay: an unacknowledged dispatch is re-checked by the stall alarm, then the head lands

replays.what: Core claim: the lost runs were an admission run (77d20db5) and a train recheck (9e7e9db0); every shape recovers
replays.test: incident a7de3a93 shape: a lost dispatch on ${name} is re-checked and every entry lands

replays.what: Core claim: the workflow_dispatch call threw after outcome=unknown; only the 12 h watchdog would have ended the run
replays.test: incident a7de3a93 replay: a dispatch that throws is reconciled by run-name at 5 min instead of waiting 12 h

replays.what: Core claim class: the older holder lost its completion wake and every supervisor task, so six Ready waiters could not unstick it
replays.test: incident c329d191 class: a holder that lost its completion wake and its alarm is re-driven by a parked reader

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-26 10:20: the landing worker parked on an error while settling a passed head; nothing woke it
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-26 10:20: a Ready head whose settlement step died is re-driven by the stall alarm

replays.what: Stalls 2026-10-26 11:16 and 12:2x: a lost check callback left the entry checking until the 12 h watchdog
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-26 11:16/12:2x: a lost check callback is replayed by the supervisor, not the 12 h watchdog

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-27 05:56: a release restart killed the controller after its claim and cancelled a checking entry
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-27 05:56: a controller killed once after its claim resumes; nothing is cancelled

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-30 00:29/00:39: batch members stranded after a fallback with no owner
replays.test: replay 108a24e3: the deadline re-drives a member orphaned after fallback and it lands

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-30 13:23: a step failed on every retry and the entry stayed pending forever
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-30 13:23/14:20: a step that fails on every retry ends with a typed reason and an alert

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-30 14:20: the 15-minute alarm retry crashed the same way as the step it repaired
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-30 14:20: the supervisor survives its own repair crashing

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-29 17:04: abandoning a Lane left its landing checking until an explicit cancel
replays.test: abandon cancels the Lane ${phase} submission through the ordinary cancellation path; replay is inert

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-31 04:32: one GitHub HTTP 500 stopped the mirror with no retry and held deploys
replays.test: real action: HTTP 500 retains the cursor, schedules one backoff, then succeeds and goes idle

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-31 04:32: a mirror 500 that persists ends terminal and visible instead of pending
replays.test: real action: five persistent 500s end terminal, visible in CLI and Now, with zero idle retries

replays.what: 2026-11-05 88-minute landing: a Ready finish stopped without scheduling its next step
replays.test: replay 2026-11-05 88-minute landing: a Ready head whose finish stopped without a next step is re-driven

replays.what: Core claim: batch a9187ad9 (normal Lane + resolution Lane c456f8db) mirrored as GitHub f233bf1c with only one member's message; the resolution landing named no message
replays.test: incident f233bf1c: a batch of a normal Lane and a resolution Lane mirrors both messages

replays.what: Core claim: a 130-path Lane on hot files took 10 land operations (about 2.5 h): each passed pre-queue check was superseded by small hot-file landings
replays.test: incident replay 10d253c6: a 130-path Lane against a stream of small hot-file landings lands within 2 attempts

replays.what: Core claim: past the diff cap every main edit to a hot file conflicted with a whole-file draft; an edit inside a removed region is now one local diff3 hunk with a suggestion
replays.test: the incident shape: a 600-line cut and a main edit elsewhere in the file merge; an edit inside the cut is one local diff3 hunk that offers the deletion

replays.what: A newly added failing test had no culprit; later failed audits restarted recovery in the same red episode and main needed a manual fix.
replays.test: incident 27865bc4: a new failing test and later failed audits recover in one automatic reverse

replays.what: Two first-check landings pass alone but fail together; recovery must revert the pair within one red episode without a manual fix.
replays.test: incident 438e9ace: two passing landings fail together and a later failed audit preserves one automatic pair recovery

replays.what: An owner-held predicted predecessor stranded a READY follower until someone approved the unrelated landing.
replays.test: incident 62033ba2: owner-held predecessor releases its follower (${identical ? 'same' : 'changed'} tree, follower ${String(followerFirst)})

replays.what: A passed three-Lane cohort was stranded behind an obsolete reservation-expiry wake after its holder ended.
replays.test: incident stucktrain: ending a reservation accepts a passed three-Lane cohort before its expiry timer (${ending})

replays.what: Core claim: passed landings waited 60-100 min behind a holder that started a new check (2026-11-17); the queue simulation gates followers' pass-to-land and fails on the pre-N1 code
replays.test: incident 5e3c3a3c: passed followers land within the pass-to-land ceiling while the holder re-checks

replays.what: Core claim: docs-only main advanced the green head without its full run, discarding a passed check with audit-baseline
replays.test: Issue 1018d0f8 / 5d690345: a docs-covered main keeps zero discarded passed runner minutes

replays.what: An alert body rewrite dropped an unmet measurement line and reconciliation closed its Issue
replays.test: incident 1018d0f8: alert refresh preserves every outstanding Done-when line and reconciliation holds it open

replays.what: A discarded operation stamp was hidden by a missing accepted-run stamp, understating the alert window
replays.test: incident f5c45985: discarded operation stamp survives a missing accepted-run stamp and joins the alert window

replays.what: Existing null alert samples need bounded one-time operation-stamp repair and explicit unknown coverage
replays.test: incident f5c45985: existing maintenance backfills null discard samples once from operation stamps and preserves unknowns

replays.what: Accepted dispatch startup_failure without a webhook strands the landing
replays.test: incident 238b3573 replay: accepted startup failure without a webhook gets one lookup at five minutes

replays.what: Twelve passing shards but run and eleven jobs stay in_progress after every step completed
replays.test: incident 238b3573 replay: signed passes and completed provider steps settle at thirty minutes despite in-progress jobs

replays.what: A composing cohort retry/split retains an obsolete finish timer; late retired callbacks can displace successor work. Failed-source handoff replay with a fresh solo plan and causal running-action cancellation; the historical long-running source action remains separately unqualified.
replays.test: incident c01d5457: failed shared compose splits ${count} saved Lanes without a watchdog or changed member pins

replays.what: A singleton cohort split leaves a newly reserved solo source generation waiting on the retired compose timer.
replays.test: c01d5457: a singleton split replaces its compose watch with the solo generation backoff

replays.what: Completed source compose stranded before admission when its desired controller cancelled a running wake; later submissions overtook it.
replays.test: incident replay 08169467: completed compose replaces a running desired wake without cancellation and lands after client exit

replays.what: Convex 1.50 throws when a running scheduled mutation cancels its own task, even though its system row remains pending.
replays.test: incident ad80e037: scheduled mutation self-cancel is skipped even while its system row is pending, without DB I/O

replays.what: An unchanged source conflict beside older board pages repeatedly wakes a landing wait.
replays.test: 9829778c: reconnecting a wait never redelivers an exact notice behind older board pages

replays.what: An overlapping full admission spends its check before composing against work already ahead.
replays.test: C1 wasted checks: overlapping admission composes before spending a check, predecessor fails=${failed}, width=${concurrency}, mode=${landingMode}
incident 95a0b4d: a batch preserves a recomposed conflict message through another resolution

replays.what: Stored order waits survive a holder generation change without a fresh claim or armed deadline; the read-only detector must expose the stale chain.
replays.test: 5e3c3a3c: holder starts a new check while followers are parked; a parked entry with no alarm is detected

replays.what: A slow older submission must retain its lifetime overtake budget while a stream of newer passes arrives.
replays.test: e4aee4fe: a slow older entry keeps its lifetime generation budget as newer passes arrive

replays.what: Passed landings waited p50 79 / p90 101 min for hours before anyone acted; the pass-to-land alarm must break on the 2026-11-17 landings and stay quiet on the accepted bench.
replays.test: incident replay 5e3c3a3c: the pass-to-land alarm breaks on the 2026-11-17 dogfood landings before the diagnosis

replays.what: Bench cohort-fail 143142 t27456: a conflict found at once after a cancelled full-admission recompose waited 921 s for the stall alarm because its one drive was lost
replays.test: incident 9a04d916: a lost drive after a cancelled admission's recompose still delivers the conflict at once

replays.what: Same incident one hop earlier (review F2): the drive that submits a cancelled admission's recompose was also an at-most-once action owned only by the 15-minute stall alarm
replays.test: incident 9a04d916 F2: the step that submits the recompose cannot be lost

replays.what: A parked Lane the queue landed after its agent stopped (receipt 1bc84170, 2026-11-17) told its Item nothing; the lead briefed a takeover for work already on main
replays.test: incident replay 2bf85ddf: a parked Lane the queue lands after its agent stopped posts its receipt to its Item

replays.what: Main went red after a landing turned on browser tests its own check skipped (2026-11-19); a skip counted as a pass, two unrelated landings were blamed and reverted, and a docs-only audit cleared the red
replays.test: incident 687d1eda: a newly covered failure names the coverage landing, reverts nothing and keeps main red

replays.what: Same incident, double loss (review ba9ce962 L2): the action uploading the recompose plan and its 30 s retry both lost (a deploy mid-action twice) left the entry to the 15-minute stall alarm
replays.test: incident 9a04d916 L2: a lost plan upload and a lost retry still deliver the conflict within one check wall

replays.what: Same incident, compose double loss (review d4f55e9f F1): the recompose's source action and then its 120 s compose watchdog action both lost left the entry to the 15-minute stall alarm
replays.test: incident 9a04d916 F1: a lost source action and its lost 120 s watchdog resume without the stall supervisor

replays.what: While main was red on a browser test (2026-11-19), every landing whose check ran browser tests failed on main's own red test and was not re-queued once main was repaired (fix D, switch FORGE_QUEUE_PARK_ON_MAIN_RED)
replays.test: incident 687d1eda D: a landing failing only on main red tests parks, then re-lands once main is green

replays.what: On 2026-11-17 main moves cancelled 57 running checks of landed work (2,977 job-min modelled) although some could still carry or seed a scoped recheck that pays; the 11-17 trace replays today's sweep against the keep rule with recorded queue waits kept
replays.test: incident fa2c1383: keeping runs where it pays cuts the 11-17 main-move waste by 30% or more without raising runner-minutes, run wall or time to main
